description: This source file defines the AppStateHolder class which manages and holds UI state for an Android application using Kotlin coroutines StateFlow. It stores various UI states such as selected tab, range, mode, and flags for logging, Wi-Fi, and mock data, along with 2D and 3D radar points.

classes.name: AppStateHolder
classes.description: A class that maintains the UI state for the app using Kotlin Flow's MutableStateFlow for reactive state management.

methods.name: <initializer>
methods.description: Initializes the AppStateHolder with default values for various UI states.
